bodončar-un: Bodončar — Bodonchar; genitive -un, 'of Bodončar' (personal name + case) [(人名的)]
töregsen: töre- — to be born; past participle -gsen, 'born, the one born' [生了的]
neretü: nere — name; possessive -tü, 'having a name, named' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [名字有的]
büleġe: bü- — to be; past büleġe, 'there was, used to be' [有來]
tere: tere — that, that one; also 'he, she' (demonstrative and third-person pronoun; plural tede) [那般]
bodončar: Bodončar — Bodonchar, a son's name (personal name) [(兒名)]
törebe: töre- — to be born; past -be, 'was born' (verb, past tense) [生了]
urida: urida — formerly, before, in front (adverb) [在前]
ügei: ügei — without, there is not (negative particle) [無]
boluγsan-u: boluγsan-u — of the one who became (bolu- + participle -γsan + genitive -u) [做了 的]
urjaṅqadai: Urjaṅqadai — a man of the Uriangqai (Urjaṅqai + -dai, person of; the suffix uncertain) [部落名]
teġün-ü-ġei: teġün-ü-ġei — his own, his (tere, stem teġün-, + genitive -ü + -ġei, which I take as 'belonging to'; uncertain) [他的]
bi: bi — I (first-person singular pronoun; the stems na-, nama-, min- before case endings) [我] · also 'is, exists' (verb, perhaps a short form of bü-, compare bijü; Ming 有)
že: že — particle, 'indeed, so' (the Ming 也者 'so be it') [(也者︀)]
oboγtu: oboγ-tu — having a clan (oboγ 'clan, lineage' + possessive -tu, back-vowel form) [姓(有的)]
boluba: bolu- — to become; past -ba, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了]
nu: -(n)u — genitive: of (back-vowel form; the n appears after a vowel-final stem) [的]
neretei: nere-tei — named, having a name (nere 'name' + possessive -tei) [名(有的)]
oboγtan: oboγ-tan — having a clan (oboγ 'clan, lineage' + plural possessive -tan) [姓(有的)]
ideġen-e: ideġen — food; dative-locative -e, 'for food' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [茶飯︀處]
tede: tede — those, they (plural of tere) [那的每]
köġüd: köġün — son; plural köġüd, 'sons' (noun + plural -d) [子每]
teriġü: teriġü — head (teriġü + possessive -tü; printed teriġü,ü but the Han reads teriġütü, 'having a head, headed') [頭 (有的)] · also plain 'head' with no ending (noun; Ming 頭)
žaγ̇ura: žaγ̇ur-a — midway, in the middle (žaγ̇ur 'middle' + dative-locative -a, back-vowel form) [路間]
bolba: bol- — to become; past -ba, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了]
nereten: nere-ten — having names, named (nere 'name' + plural possessive -ten) [名(有)的(每)]
sünid: sün — night; plural sünid, 'nights' (noun + plural -d) [夜(每)]
qojar: qojar — two; it follows the pair it counts [兩箇]
in-ü: in-ü — his, her, its (third-person genitive, placed after its noun) [他的]
ede: ede — these (plural of ene) (demonstrative pronoun) [這(的每)]
onan: Onan — the Onon, the river of Chinggis's homeland [河名, 'name of a river']
aba: a- — to be, to dwell; past -ba, 'dwelt' (verb, past tense) [住了]
köġüdi: köġüd(i) — sons; the (i) is read as the accusative -i (the Ming marks 行) before the reflexive -(i)jen (köġün + plural -d) [子每(自的)行]
jen: -(i)jen — reflexive-possessive, one's own (front-vowel form; the token left after köġüd(i)-; here 'her own') [子每(自的)行] · also after ger-tür(i)- (dative-locative), 'one's own home'
böġetele: bü- — to be (böġe- before an ending); converb -tele, 'while, although' (verb, converb) [旣]
bükün: bü- — to be; -kün, participle 'the ones that are' (verb, participle; uncertain) [有的]
ögčü: ög- — to give; converb -čü after a consonant, 'giving' (verb, converb) [與着]
irgen: irgen — people, the common folk of a camp or realm [百姓]
ni: -(n)i — accusative, marks the object (e.g. ökin-(n)i 'the girl' as object); the Ming writes 行 (case suffix) [女 行]
barižu: bari- — to take hold of, grasp; converb -žu (verb, converb) [拿着]
abču: ab- — to take; converb -ču, 'taking' (verb, converb) [要着]
ügülerün: ügüle- — to speak, to say; converb -rün, 'saying' [說]
keġen: keġe- — to say; keġen 'saying', the converb that closes a quotation (verb, converb) [麽道]
qamuγ-un: qamuγ-un — of all, of everyone (qamuγ 'all' + genitive -un, back-vowel form after a consonant) [普的]
jan: -(i)jan — reflexive-possessive, one's own (back-vowel form; the token left after γažar-tur(i)- and γažar(i)-) [地 自的行] · also after aqui-dur(i)- (a participle with dative-locative)
min-u: min-u — my, of me (bi, genitive stem min-, + -u, set after its noun) [我的]
čaγ-tur: čaγ — time, season; dative-locative -tur, 'at the time' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [時 裏]
aisuqu-ji: aisu- — to come, to approach; imperfective participle -qu with accusative -ji, 'the coming (of them)' [來的行]
žoluγažu: žoluγa- — to meet, come upon; converb -žu (verb, converb) [遇着]
ger-türi: ger — dwelling, tent; dative-locative -tür(i), 'to the tent' (noun + case; the (i) is Shiratori's) [房子 自的(行)]
aqa-juγ̇an: aqa — elder brother; reflexive-possessive -juγ̇an after a vowel, 'one's own elder brother' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [兄 自的]
uduridču: uduri- — to lead, guide; converb -dču, 'leading' (verb, converb; a form of -žu, the d is unexplained) [引着]
